headline: Bulgaria Wins Eurovision 2026 with DARA's "Bangaranga"
deck: DARA delivered Bulgaria's first-ever Eurovision victory in Vienna, earning 516 points in the 70th contest.
summary: Bulgaria won the Eurovision Song Contest 2026 on May 16 in Vienna, with DARA's "Bangaranga" earning 516 points and securing the nation's first-ever victory in the competition's 70-year history. The contest featured 35 participating broadcasters and introduced new rules including the return of jury voting to semi-finals at 50% weighting. Ukraine's entry also made history by holding the contest's longest-ever note.
